summary: Router 0.25.0, ADR-0076. New deletion_journal.py: completed API deletions of sessions (session_api delete) and memory operations (memory_gateway operation delete) are appended as {ts, kind, owner, id} to deletions.jsonl next to config.yaml (open_private, owner-only; write failures logged once). session_api.lifecycle replays it right after the store opens and before the memory lifecycle starts the outbox worker; an unreadable journal or a database error aborts the start. Schema migration adds memory_outbox.session_id (nullable) with a partial index. reliability_store: outbox_put stores session_id; _request_deletion applies the API deletion transitions in bulk while keeping the stored scope (never sent -> deleted without payload, possibly in Hindsight -> delete_pending with retry_base, processing -> delete_requested only); outbox_finish turns accepted/completed/pending of a delete_requested row into delete_pending; replay_deletions deletes journaled sessions and marks journaled operations (and, with the option, the operations of journaled sessions) in one transaction; outbox_stuck_deletions; outbox_deleted_documents pages sent-and-deleted operations by id; cleanup can mark memory of expired sessions. session_store.delete runs in a transaction and optionally marks the session's operations first. New session_store.delete_memory_with_session (bool, default false), example config, posture infos session_retention_off, memory_kept_on_session_delete, outbox_payload_retention_off. memory.Capture records the session id; memory.prepare sets req.memory_operation (HMAC operation id) for retaining requests, returned as X-Skirnir-Memory-Operation. Admin POST /admin/memory/reconcile-deletions on the control port (basic auth middleware) validates after/limit, deletes each listed document again via the Hindsight client, returns counts and next, audits counts. Gauge skirnir_memory_deletions_stuck. Decision capture rotates at 64 MiB to one .1 file. .gitignore for test journals. Docs EN/DE (design/memory-reliability lifecycle table, operations restore order, clients header), threat model and register TM-12, CHANGELOG.

findings.evidence: Deletion tombstones lived in the same database as the data; a restored older database resent pending rows of deleted knowledge; a restored Hindsight kept deleted documents; session deletion left retained memory with no way for the owner to find its id.
findings.resolution: Journal outside the database replayed before the outbox starts; admin reconcile for Hindsight; opt-in session memory deletion; operation id header; in-flight deletions taken over.

findings.evidence: Session deletion with memory must not touch other owners' rows even with a colliding session id.
findings.resolution: All bulk updates are scoped by owner and session or operation id; the integration test covers another owner with the same session id.

findings.evidence: The journal and the reconcile answer could become new content stores.
findings.resolution: Ids, kind and owner only; owner-only file; reconcile returns and audits counts only.

tests.command: python test/selftest_deletion_lifecycle.py; selftest_posture; selftest_pydeps; selftest_sbom; lock_requirements.py check; ruff check .; check_control_flow; check_pinned_references; check_adr_index; selftest_english_names; router.py --check config.example.yaml --pure
tests.evidence: all passed on Windows; ADR index ok: 76 ADRs.

tests.command: pg-testlauf: every python step of ci.yml jobs python and sessions-postgres with PostgreSQL 16 (WSL), including test/integration_deletion_lifecycle.py
tests.evidence: integration_deletion_lifecycle ok, integration_sessions/context/interoperability ok; selftest_memory fixed for the new Capture field; three tests need pip or packaging, which that venv lacks (they pass with pip, as in CI).

limitations: Derived Hindsight observations are removed by Hindsight with their document; the opt-in live test was not extended.
The journal must not be restored older than the database; documented as an operational rule.
A deletion requested while an API delete is in flight still answers 409 for that single call.
